summary: Session 10 — 4 new Reports & Analytics admin endpoints (/api/analytics/{enhanced, revenue-overview, transactions, location-overview}) + 4 new admin dashboard tabs (Analytics, Revenue, Transactions, Location). Backend: 14/14 passed in test_reports_analytics.py (unauth→401/403, non-admin→403, admin→200 with strict shape checks on every response). Verified enhanced.overview has all 8 required keys (total_streams=60, revenue_streams, unique_listeners=4, total_listening_hours=3.8, avg_session_duration=3.8, gross_revenue=8000, platform_revenue=2400, unique_songs_played=15) + top_songs[] with {title,artist,plays} + category_breakdown[]. revenue-overview: currency=TZS, daily[14] with {date,amount}, platform_earnings(2400) + artist_payouts(5600) = gross_revenue(8000), top_artists/top_albums/all_artists all arrays. transactions: summary{total, completed_revenue, pending, failed, currency}, gateways=['azampay_simulated'], transactions[] with no _id leak; status=completed filter returns only completed rows. location-overview: total_users=48, total_countries=1 (Tanzania), countries=[{name,value}], growth[6] with {month,new,cumulative}. FRONTEND (390x844, admin@vibe.app): admin-menu opens accordion drawer, Reports & Analytics group expanded by default, all 6 nav items present (nav-dashboard, nav-analytics, nav-location-analytics, nav-revenue, nav-transactions, nav-withdrawals). Analytics tab renders 6 stat cards + Top Songs (5 songs w/ play counts) + Category pie donut. Revenue tab renders 4 cards + Revenue Over Time area chart (14-day) + Top Artists + Top Albums. Transactions tab renders 4 summary cards + 4 filter chips (tx-filter-all/completed/pending/failed all tappable, tapping tx-filter-completed triggers refetch — no error). Location tab renders 2 cards + Users by Country bar (Tanzania, 48) + User Growth dual line chart (Cumulative + New, 6 months). No red screen, no page errors, no console errors related to Reports & Analytics. Only warning is generic 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (RN Web internal, not our code).

issues: Segmented control still only exposes Dashboard/Content/Users. When tab is analytics/revenue/transactions/location/artists/withdrawals, NONE of the visible segment buttons appears selected — user only sees the pageTitle ('Analytics', 'Revenue…', etc.) as an indicator. Same observation raised in iter_13. Consider hiding the segment control when tab is drawer-only, or replacing it with a dynamic breadcrumb reflecting current tab.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Review request referenced testID 'nav-location' but the actual rendered testID is 'nav-location-analytics' (slug of the full label 'Location Analytics'). Both are valid — either rename the sidebar label to 'Location' for a shorter testID, or keep as-is and update any downstream docs to use 'nav-location-analytics'.

OPTIONAL: /admin index.tsx is now 1086 lines (up from 897 in iter_13) — still growing. Extracting AnalyticsTab, RevenueTab, TransactionsTab, LocationTab into /admin/tabs/*.tsx would keep files under the 700-line soft limit and simplify future admin work.

OPTIONAL: /api/analytics/transactions uses .to_list(200) with no pagination cursor — fine for now (only ~16 completed txns in DB) but add ?limit / ?offset query params before the transaction volume grows.

OPTIONAL (design): Consider hiding or replacing the top Dashboard/Content/Users segmented control when the active tab is one of the drawer-only tabs (analytics, revenue, transactions, location, artists, withdrawals), since none of the segment buttons visually reflects the current tab. See design_issues above.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/analytics.py:302-310 revenue-overview.daily runs 14 sequential DB queries (one per day). For 14 days this is fine (<300ms observed) but if window grows, refactor to a single aggregation with $bucket by day.

backend/routers/analytics.py:313-323 revenue-overview iterates ALL artists and does 2 queries per artist (songs.distinct + play_events.count_documents). With ~5 artists it's fine; at scale (>100 artists) this is O(N) round-trips. Consider a single $lookup/$facet aggregation.

backend/routers/analytics.py:246-247 PLATFORM_CUT=0.30 and PER_PLAY=50 are hard-coded module constants — good for now, but move to settings/env so the platform economics can be adjusted without redeploy.

backend/routers/analytics.py:394-396 location-overview uses cumulative = users.count_documents({created_at:{$lt:end}}) per month — 6 queries but $lt over the same collection could be a single aggregate; minor optimisation.
frontend/app/admin/index.tsx (1086 lines) — over the 700 soft limit; extract tab renderers into components.

frontend/app/admin/index.tsx:172-175 useEffect refetches transactions on EVERY txStatus change (correct), but analytics/revenue/location gate on `&& !enhanced` so they only fetch once — if user later mutates data (e.g., adds a song) the analytics tab will show stale numbers until a hard reload. Consider adding a pull-to-refresh / refetch button, or invalidate on focus.
